about: Files restored byte for byte from the retired bitfield-packages repository (standing order: originals move wholesale, no rewrites from scratch).

calls.means: A path in one person's home folder names that person; made relative to the repository folder it was in.
A real business's public host name in a test fixture; a public tree holds made-up names only.
A real business's app name in a test fixture; made up.
The name of one business's fork of the server, in comments and the guard that no tenant is named; made generic.
One business's asset folder in a comment; made generic.
A header name that carried one business's name, in the test that no tenant name survives in a header; made generic.
The words a guard test refuses in a page and a server config (one business's name and its field of work); made-up words stand in.
An old environment-variable prefix that carried one business's name, in the README history; made generic.
An install folder named for one business, in the README history; made generic.
A real person's first name in a test principal; a made-up name stands in.
A fixture title named one person's field of work; a public tree holds made-up fixtures only.
A fixture word named one person's field of work; a public tree holds made-up fixtures only.
A well-known real person's name in a comment about a page route; a public tree holds made-up names only.
A test fixture secret written in the shape of a live payment key; a plainly fake value stands in.
A path in one person's home folder names that person; the folder prefix is dropped and the path starts at the repository folder it was in.
A path into the maker's private notes, named as notes/ instead.
A test address with a user part shaped like a real mailbox; the user part left out.
